name: patrol
summary: Every 30 minutes, find open pull requests of Cloving whose run ended blocked or failed and hand at most four of them to rescue-pr. Hand at most four quiet pull requests with open review threads to answer-review.

points.question: What happens when the patrol finds stuck pull requests?

options.label: Ask a person first
options.summary: One decision lists the candidates. The person picks the pull requests to rescue. Nothing is handed off before the decision.
options.change: Keep askPerson as pickPulls from patrol/pick.ts in patrol.ts. Keep selection.act as ask in patrol/scenarios.ts.

options.label: Hand off at once
options.summary: Hand off a rescue for each candidate without a decision, at most four for each pass.
options.change: In patrol.ts replace askPerson as pickPulls with pickAll as pickPulls in the patrol/pick.ts import. Set selection.act to now in patrol/scenarios.ts.
